title: Summer with Ensana in Marienbad
metaDescription: Join the Ensana summer competition: 10 fun questions about Marienbad and a prize draw for a stay for two at the Hvězda hotel.

intro.text: We've prepared a summer competition for you. Ten questions about Marienbad await — some test your memory, others your imagination. Everyone who reaches the end and leaves us their email enters the draw for a stay at the Ensana Hvězda hotel.
intro.prize: Grand prize: 2 nights for 2 — a Mini Spa Break (Minikúra) at the Ensana Hvězda hotel
intro.drawNote: The draw takes place on 1 September.

questions.text: How many mineral springs rise directly in Marienbad?
questions.explanation: Around 40 springs rise in the town itself, with roughly 100 more in the surroundings. One stay won't be enough to taste them all.

questions.text: Which crowned guest loved Marienbad so much that he still has his own spa cabin here?
questions.explanation: King Edward VII — you can still find his Royal Cabin at the Ensana Nové Lázně hotel.

questions.text: Which composer gives his name to the town's famous music festival?
questions.explanation: The Chopin Festival — Chopin, like Goethe, was one of the town's famous visitors.

questions.text: Marienbad has been UNESCO-listed since 2021. Under what title?
questions.explanation: Together with other renowned spas, Marienbad has been part of the UNESCO series “Great Spa Towns of Europe” since 2021.

questions.text: What does the famous fountain by the colonnade do that keeps drawing the crowds?

options.text: It changes colour with the weather
It fires a 30-metre jet every hour

questions.explanation: The Singing Fountain is one of the town's landmarks — its water display comes alive with music.

questions.text: Maria's Spring doesn't produce water, but something else. What?
questions.explanation: Maria's gas is 99.7% carbon dioxide of volcanic origin, used for gas injections and dry gas baths.

questions.text: What is the Ensana Hvězda hotel — home of our grand prize — famous for?

options.text: The largest hotel pool in town

questions.explanation: The Hvězda hotel boasts the largest hotel pool in Marienbad — plus several saunas and a salt cave.

questions.text: In which hotel can you bathe in the historic Roman Baths of 1896?
questions.explanation: The Roman Baths at the five-star Nové Lázně hotel have welcomed guests since 1896.

questions.text: How long is Marienbad's spa tradition?
questions.explanation: The spa tradition dates back to 1808. Since 2023, Marienbad has also been an official climatic spa.

questions.text: And finally, no tricks this time: what does your dream spa summer look like? Tell us in a few words.
questions.placeholder: E.g. a morning cup at the spring, afternoons by the pool…

results.title: Spa connoisseur!
results.message: Brilliant! You could be giving tours of the colonnade. Only one thing left — come and enjoy summer with Ensana in person.

results.title: Almost a local
results.message: Great effort! Marienbad still keeps a few secrets from you — best uncovered right at the springs.

results.title: One more reason to visit
results.message: No worries! All of this is best learnt right on the colonnade. And you're in the draw either way.

terms.heading: Terms of the “Summer with Ensana in Marienbad” competition
terms.body:
1. The competition is organised by Léčebné lázně Mariánské Lázně a.s., Masarykova 22, 353 01 Mariánské Lázně, Czech Republic, operator of the Ensana hotels in Marienbad (the “Organiser”).

2. The competition runs on marienbad.com until 31 August 2026 (23:59 CET). The draw takes place on 1 September 2026.

3. Any natural person over 18 may enter by completing the quiz, providing their first name, last name and email address, and confirming consent to the processing of personal data. Each person may enter only once; the first registration of a given email address counts. Employees of the Organiser and their family members are excluded from the competition.

4. The prize is a voucher for a stay for 2 persons for 2 nights with the Mini Spa Break (Minikúra) package at the Ensana Hvězda hotel in Marienbad, as per the hotel's current offer.

5. The voucher is valid until 30 June 2027. It cannot be redeemed between 20 December 2026 and 6 January 2027. The stay is subject to hotel availability and must be booked in advance.

6. The winner will be drawn on 1 September 2026 and notified by email at the address provided in the entry form. If the winner does not respond within 14 days, a substitute winner will be drawn.

7. The prize cannot be exchanged for cash.

8. Data protection. The data controller is Léčebné lázně Mariánské Lázně a.s., ID No. 45359113, registered office Masarykova 22/5, 353 01 Mariánské Lázně (contact: webmaster.cz@ensanahotels.com). a) Purpose and legal basis: the data is processed to run and evaluate the competition (performance of the competition terms) and — based on consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR — to send the newsletter. b) Data collected: first name, last name, email address, language version, competition name, score achieved and the record of consent. c) Recipients and processors: the data may be shared with processors handling operations and email delivery, in particular MailerLite (contact storage) and VirtualZoom (newsletter delivery), under concluded data-processing agreements. d) Transfers outside the EU: where a processor is established outside the European Economic Area, transfers take place only with appropriate safeguards under the GDPR (in particular the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses). e) Retention: for the competition, for its duration and settlement; for the newsletter, until consent is withdrawn. f) Your rights: you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, objection, and the right to withdraw consent at any time (withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal). g) You may withdraw consent free of charge at any time via the unsubscribe link in every email or at webmaster.cz@ensanahotels.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Czech Data Protection Authority (Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů, Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Prague 7, www.uoou.cz). See also the privacy policy for details.

9. The Organiser reserves the right to amend these terms in justified cases or to suspend or cancel the competition. The prize is not legally enforceable.
